---
title: "W08_task2"
format: html
---


```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(sf)
```

```{r}
dir.create("data")

download.file(url = "https://byuistats.github.io/M335/data/Wells.zip", destfile = "data/Wells.zip", mode = "wb")

download.file(url = "https://byuistats.github.io/M335/data/Idaho_Dams.zip", destfile = "data/Idaho_Dams.zip", mode = "wb")

download.file(url = "https://byuistats.github.io/M335/data/water.zip", destfile = "data/water.zip", mode = "wb")

download.file(url = "https://byuistats.github.io/M335/data/shp.zip", destfile = "data/shp.zip", mode = "wb")

unzip("data/Wells.zip", exdir = "data/wells")
unzip("data/Idaho_Dams.zip", exdir = "data/dams")
unzip("data/water.zip", exdir = "data/water")
unzip("data/shp.zip", exdir = "data/idaho")

wells <- st_read("data/wells/Wells.shp")
dams <- st_read("data/dams/Dam_Safety.shp")
water <- st_read("data/water/hyd250.shp")
idaho <- st_read("data/idaho/County-Ak-HI-Moved-USA-Map.shp")
```

```{r}
names(wells)
names(dams)
names(water)
names(idaho)
```

```{r}
wells_filtered <- wells %>%
  filter(Production > 5000)
```

```{r}
dams_filtered <- dams %>%
  filter(SurfaceAre > 50)
```

```{r}
water_filtered <- water %>%
  filter(FEAT_NAME%in% c("Snake River", "Henrys Fork"))
```

```{r}
idaho_filtered <- idaho %>%
  filter(StateFIPSN == "16")

idaho_projected <- st_transform(idaho_filtered, 26911)
wells_projected <- st_transform(wells_filtered, 26911)
dams_projected <- st_transform(dams_filtered, 26911)
water_projected <- st_transform(water_filtered, 26911)
```

```{r}
idaho_water_map <- ggplot() +
  geom_sf(data = idaho_projected, fill = "gray", color = "black", linewidth = 0.6) +
  geom_sf(data = water_projected, color = "blue", linewidth = 0.8) +
  geom_sf(data = dams_projected, color = "darkred", size = 2, alpha = 0.8) +
  geom_sf(data = wells_projected, color = "darkgreen", size = 1.5, alpha = 0.7) +
  coord_sf(expand = FALSE) +
  labs(title = "Key Water System Features in Idaho") +
  theme_void()

idaho_water_map
```

```{r}
ggsave(filename = "idaho_water_system_map.png", plot = idaho_water_map, width = 10, height = 12, units = "in")
```
